admin_manual.label: Admin manual
admin_manual.summary: Read the administrator-facing runbooks such as device setup (separate from the public manual).

system.label: System admin
system.summary: Change system-side settings: app management, price estimate engine, links, order intake, AI provider, notification email.

kiosk.label: Shared device admin
kiosk.summary: View shared devices and edit their name and location. **Revealing secrets and enrolling or revoking devices are separate** (see privileged operations).

kiosk_secret.label: Shared device secrets
kiosk_secret.summary: Reveal the maintenance-exit PIN, PIN history and device settings code; regenerate codes and reset the device key.

kiosk_device.label: Shared device enrolment
kiosk_device.summary: Create, link, activate, disable and revoke device profiles. Adding a device grants access.

kiosk_card.label: Shared device card issuance
kiosk_card.summary: See the card list. Issuing, assigning, revoking, resetting PINs and printing sheets need approval.

personal_data.label: Personal data access
personal_data.summary: Open login and activity history. Details (IP, device signature) and cross-document search need approval. Per-document history tabs are not restricted by this.

user_admin.label: User administration
user_admin.summary: Open user management. Suspending, restoring and changing plants go through a per-change approval.

portal_admin.label: Partner portal administration
portal_admin.summary: Manage the accounts external partners use to view their own documents, and the per-document links. Activating an account, issuing backup codes and minting link-only URLs each need approval.

PERMISSION_GROUP_SUMMARY.business: Permissions for everyday work, split by the document you handle — quotes, order acceptances, work orders, delivery orders. Most people hold only these.
PERMISSION_GROUP_SUMMARY.master: Permissions for the shared reference data everyone works from. Changing a partner or product affects every document created afterwards, so these are usually held by a few people.
PERMISSION_GROUP_SUMMARY.admin: Permissions that change the system itself — how screens behave, external integrations — rather than business data.
PERMISSION_GROUP_SUMMARY.privileged: Permissions that holding is not enough for. Device PINs, card issuance and personal-data access sit here — operations with wide reach and little way back. Each use is requested and allowed only for a window someone else approves.

reveal_unlock_pin.label: Reveal maintenance PIN
reveal_unlock_pin.description: Shows the shared maintenance-exit PIN in clear text. It exits kiosk mode on every device.

reveal_pin_history.label: Reveal PIN history
reveal_pin_history.description: Lists up to 400 days of past exit PINs — needed for offline devices, but broader than the current value.

reveal_device_pin.label: Reveal the PIN a device holds
reveal_device_pin.description: Shows the exit PIN last delivered to that device — used to open an offline tablet.

reveal_settings_code.label: Reveal device settings code
reveal_settings_code.description: Shows the code that unlocks that device's hidden settings screen.

regenerate_settings_code.label: Regenerate device settings code
regenerate_settings_code.description: Issues a new settings code; anyone holding the old one loses access.

reset_device_key.label: Reset device attestation key
reset_device_key.description: Clears the attestation binding so the next device to connect is trusted (TOFU). Only for hardware replacement.

create_profile.label: Create device profile
create_profile.description: Creates the slot a new tablet can be linked into.

link.label: Link a device
link.description: Binds real hardware to a profile and issues its device token.

activate.label: Activate a device
activate.description: Brings a linked device into service so employees can log in on it.

set_enabled.label: Disable / enable a device
set_enabled.description: Suspends a device or brings a suspended one back.

unlink.label: Unlink
unlink.description: Destroys the device token, sessions and attestation key, reopening the profile.

revoke.label: Revoke a device
revoke.description: Locks the device out immediately, cutting live shop-floor sessions.

pair_display.label: Pair a display
pair_display.description: Adds a shop-floor screen. A paired display shows business data where anyone can see it.

revoke_display.label: Revoke a display
revoke_display.description: Locks the display out immediately; it returns to the pairing screen on next reload.

issue.label: Issue cards
issue.description: Creates new QR cards. The QR payload is the credential itself.

assign.label: Assign / reassign a card
assign.description: Binds a card to an employee. After reassignment, actions are recorded under the new person.

revoke.label: Revoke a card
revoke.description: Permanently disables a card — correct for a lost card, and irreversible.

reset_pin.label: Reset a card PIN
reset_pin.description: Clears the PIN so it is set again at next login. In the wrong hands this is account takeover.

unlock_pin.label: Release a PIN lockout
unlock_pin.description: Clears the 15-minute lockout caused by five failed PIN attempts.

update_validity.label: Change card validity
update_validity.description: Changes how long a card works; extending it revives an expired card.

update_session_limit.label: Change concurrent session limit
update_session_limit.description: Changes how many sessions one card may hold at once; raising it hides card sharing.

print.label: Print the card sheet
print.description: Renders the QR codes into a printable PDF — the credential leaves the system as a file.

login_history_detail.label: Login history detail
login_history_detail.description: Opens one auth event down to IP, device signature and ownership — adjacent to employee monitoring.

activity_search.label: Cross-document activity search
activity_search.description: Searches what one person did across all documents. Per-document history tabs are not restricted by this.

activity_detail.label: Activity log detail
activity_detail.description: Opens one operation down to its before/after payload.

activate_account.label: Activate a portal account
activate_account.description: Gives an external person a standing login to their own documents.

issue_backup_codes.label: Issue backup codes
issue_backup_codes.description: Prints one-time codes that bypass e-mail possession. The paper is the key.

mint_link_only.label: Mint a link-only URL
mint_link_only.description: Creates a document URL anyone holding it can open. Verified links are not gated.

customer.label: Customer
customer.summary: Select the customer this quote is for. The unit price is determined from this customer's price list, so select it first.

customerBranch.label: Branch
customerBranch.summary: Select the destination branch. This cannot be selected if no branches are registered for this customer (leaving it blank is fine).

validUntil.label: Valid until
validUntil.summary: The last day this quote is valid. Quotes past this date can be treated as "Expired" in the list.

status.label: Status
status.summary: The quote's current status. New quotes start as "Draft".

product.label: Product
product.summary: Select the product to quote. Once selected, the unit price matching the combination of customer, order type, and quantity is filled in automatically from the price list.

orderType.label: Order type
orderType.summary: Classifies the order as Production, Test, Sample, or Other. Even for the same product, prices differ by type, so choose according to the actual order (samples are treated as ¥0).

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: Enter the number of pieces. If the price list sets unit prices by quantity range, the unit price changes according to the quantity entered.

deliveryDate.label: Delivery date
deliveryDate.summary: The planned date to deliver this line item to the customer. Can be set per line item.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Internal notes. These do not appear on the quote PDF.

customer.label: Customer
customer.summary: The customer this pricing applies to. The combination of customer and product forms one price list entry, and cannot be changed after creation.

product.label: Product
product.summary: The product this pricing applies to. Like the customer, this cannot be changed after creation.

orderType.label: Order type
orderType.summary: Classifies the order as Production, Test, Sample, or Other. Even for the same customer and product, each type can have a different price.

basePrice.label: Base unit price
basePrice.summary: The unit price that quantity tiers are based on. Each tier's unit price is determined by multiplying this price by its multiplier.

validFrom.label: Valid from
validFrom.summary: The date this price becomes effective. When creating a quote, the price effective at that time is used.

validUntil.label: Valid until
validUntil.summary: The date this price stops being effective. Leave blank for no end date.

multiplier.label: Multiplier
multiplier.summary: The multiplier applied for each quantity range. Enter a value less than 1 to lower the unit price for larger quantities.

customPrice.label: Custom price
customPrice.summary: Use this to manually set the unit price for just that tier. If entered, it takes priority over the multiplier-based calculation.

customer.label: Customer
customer.summary: The customer who placed the order. This is determined automatically from the imported order document, but if it cannot be determined, select it here.

customerOrderRef.label: Customer order ref.
customerOrderRef.summary: The number written on the customer's own order document. This number can be used to look up the order later when the customer inquires.

quoteNumber.label: Quote
quoteNumber.summary: The quote this order is based on. If specified, that issued quote is automatically set to "Accepted" when this order is confirmed.

orderDate.label: Order date
orderDate.summary: The date the customer placed the order. Enter the date written on the order document.

shipTo.label: Ship-to
shipTo.summary: The delivery destination for the product. Select this when delivering to a different company or branch than the customer who placed the order. Leaving it blank means delivery to the customer.

deliveryMethod.label: Delivery method
deliveryMethod.summary: Standard delivery — delivers to the ordering customer (or its ship-to). Direct to end user — delivers directly to the end user. A delivery order can only combine orders with the same ship-to and delivery method.

endUser.label: End user
endUser.summary: The actual delivery destination (end user). Required when Direct to end user is selected; optional as a record even with standard delivery.

assignedPlant.label: Assigned site
assignedPlant.summary: The site primarily responsible for handling this order. Select this to clarify which site the work belongs to.

shippingWorkLocation.label: Shipping work location
shippingWorkLocation.summary: The location where shipping work (packing, loading, etc.) is performed. Select from the work location master.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Notes for the order acceptance as a whole. For notes on individual line items, use the notes field on each row.

product.label: Product
product.summary: The ordered product. This is automatically matched from the item name on the order document, but the match can fail — in that case, select it manually.

orderType.label: Order type
orderType.summary: Classifies the order as Production, Test, Sample, or Other. Prices differ by this classification.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: The ordered quantity. Correct it if the extracted result is inaccurate.

unitPrice.label: Unit price
unitPrice.summary: The price per piece. If it differs from the price list's unit price, the difference is shown immediately.

deliveryDate.label: Delivery date
deliveryDate.summary: The delivery date for this line item. If not specified on the line item, the header's requested delivery date is used.

itemNotes.label: Line item notes
itemNotes.summary: Notes for this line item only (e.g. version number or custom details).

trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.summary: Select whether this request is for a quote, made after an order is confirmed, or standalone (neither). Choosing "At quote" or "At order" determines whether you next link a Quote or an Order line. Choosing "Standalone" hides the linking field — use this for requests at a stage before any document exists, such as evaluating a new product or a preliminary customer inquiry.

quote.label: Quote
quote.summary: Select this when the trigger is "At quote". Recording which quote the design is for makes it possible to trace the background later.

orderLine.label: Order line
orderLine.summary: Select this when the trigger is "At order". Records which order the design is for.

product.label: Product
product.summary: The product the drawing is for. Required. Whether this becomes a "New" or "Revision" request is determined automatically by whether this product already has a past design document. Even a brand-new product that isn't registered yet can be added to the product master with just a name and unit, so register it first before submitting the request.

assignee.label: Assignee
assignee.summary: The production staff member who will create the drawing. Once approved, this person receives a notification to start work. It can still be changed from "…" after approval.

desiredAt.label: Requested date
desiredAt.summary: The date by which the drawing is needed. It can be left blank when registering, but entering it allows sorting in the list and highlights overdue items by color.

priority.label: Priority
priority.summary: Normal or High. If a requested date is set, that serves as the guide, so priority is used for cases like "the deadline is further out, but please start on this first".

baseDesignFile.label: Base drawing
baseDesignFile.summary: For a revision, which version to redraw from. If left blank, the latest version at the time of determination is used. If another revision is completed first while this request is pending, that fact is recorded in the history when it completes.

changeReason.label: Reason for change
changeReason.summary: For a revision, describe why it is being redrawn. This is a separate field from the request description, and serves as a clue when tracing differences between versions later.

description.label: Request description
description.summary: Describe what needs to be designed. The production staff member creates the drawing based solely on this text, so be specific about dimensions, shape, reference to existing products, and points to note.

customer.label: Customer
customer.summary: Who this price estimate is for. It can be calculated even if left blank — useful for a rough estimate before a customer has been decided.

product.label: Product
product.summary: The product this price estimate is for. Linking it to a product allows it to be selected as the base unit price source for the price list after confirmation.

maxDiameter.label: Max diameter (mm)
maxDiameter.summary: The product's maximum diameter. Serves as a guide when selecting the material diameter.

length.label: Overall length (mm)
length.summary: The product's length. Since material cost is determined by length, changing this changes the material cost.

materialType.label: Material type
materialType.summary: The type of material to use. Select from types determined by the combination of manufacturer and grade.

diameter.label: Diameter
diameter.summary: The material's diameter. Select one larger than the product's maximum diameter.

surfaceFinish.label: Surface finish
surfaceFinish.summary: The material's surface condition. Black scale (as-rolled) is cheaper, but may require an additional centerless grinding charge.

cylinderType.label: Cylinder type
cylinderType.summary: Select this when the tool type is Cylinder. Machining cost varies by type.

stepMachining.label: Step machining length (mm) / Step machining type
stepMachining.summary: The length and type of step machining. Cost is determined by the combination of length and type.

neckMachining.label: Neck machining length (mm) / Neck machining type
neckMachining.summary: The length and type of neck machining. As with step machining, leave blank if not performed.

machiningTime.label: Machining time (min)
machiningTime.summary: The machining time per piece. Machining cost is calculated from this time, so enter a value close to the actual setup.

coating.label: Coating
coating.summary: The type of coating. Selecting one adds the corresponding cost.

inspectionReport.label: Inspection certificate
inspectionReport.summary: Whether to include an inspection certificate. Including one adds an inspection cost.

ld.label: LD machining / LD position / LD outer diameter (mm) / LD flute length (mm)
ld.summary: The conditions when LD machining is performed. Entering "LD machining" allows you to specify the position, outer diameter, and flute length.

reason.label: Reason for request
reason.summary: Explain why this material is needed. The approver will judge based on this, so noting which product and which step it is for will reduce back-and-forth.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary notes for the request as a whole. For notes about a specific material only, use the notes field on that line item.

material.label: Material
material.summary: Select the material you need. If it is not in the list, register it in the material master first.

plant.label: Receiving site
plant.summary: The site that will receive this material. It will be added to that site's stock, so choose the site where it will actually be used.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: Enter the quantity needed. The same quantity will carry over to the purchase order later.

unit.label: Unit
unit.summary: The unit of measure, such as pcs, kg, or m. Selecting a material fills in its default unit.

desiredDate.label: Requested date
desiredDate.summary: The date by which you would like the material. This is not a fixed schedule — the actual expected arrival date is set with the supplier when creating the purchase order.

itemNotes.label: Line item notes
itemNotes.summary: Notes for this material only (e.g. "same lot as last time").

supplier.label: Supplier
supplier.summary: The company you are purchasing the material from. If it is not in the list, register it in the business partner master.

orderDate.label: Order date
orderDate.summary: The date the order is placed. If left blank, the date you click "Order" will be filled in automatically.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary notes for the purchase order as a whole. For notes about a specific material only, use the notes field on that line item.

material.label: Material
material.summary: Select the material to order. If the purchase order was created from a purchase request, the request's details carry over.

plant.label: Receiving site
plant.summary: The site that will receive this material. Recording the receipt increases stock at this site.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: The quantity being ordered. It can be received in multiple partial deliveries if the shipment arrives in separate batches.

unit.label: Unit
unit.summary: The unit of measure, such as pcs, kg, or m. Selecting a material fills in its default unit.

unitPrice.label: Unit price
unitPrice.summary: The price per unit. The amount entered here is used as the reference price for material cost in price estimates, so enter the actual transaction price.

expectedDate.label: Expected date
expectedDate.summary: The date this material is expected to arrive. Enter the date agreed with the supplier.

itemNotes.label: Line item notes
itemNotes.summary: Notes for this material only. For notes about the purchase order as a whole, use the notes field above.

material.label: Material
material.summary: Select the material that arrived. If recording the receipt from a purchase order, the order's details carry over.

supplier.label: Supplier
supplier.summary: The company that delivered the material. This is filled in automatically when receiving from a purchase order.

plant.label: Receiving site
plant.summary: The site that actually received the material. Stock at this site will increase, so choose the site where the shipment arrived.

receivedDate.label: Received date
receivedDate.summary: The date the material was received. Stock increases on this date.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: The quantity actually received. It does not need to match the ordered quantity — if delivered in separate batches, record only the amount received.

unit.label: Unit
unit.summary: The unit of measure, such as pcs, kg, or m. Selecting a material fills in its default unit.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Additional notes. Record anything you might want to check later, such as damage or a quantity discrepancy.

orderLine.label: Order line allocation
orderLine.summary: Which order line(s) this work order is for. Adding rows lets you combine multiple order lines for the same product into one work order (one lot), or conversely split a single order line across multiple work orders. This can be left empty for a work order that only builds stock.

allocQuantity.label: Allocation quantity
allocQuantity.summary: The quantity to make for that order line. The maximum is the line's remaining allocatable amount (the order quantity minus what other work orders already allocate).

product.label: Target product
product.summary: The product to make. If an order line is selected, its product is filled in automatically.

plannedQuantity.label: Planned quantity
plannedQuantity.summary: The quantity to make. Enter an amount at least equal to the total allocations (you may add extra to allow for defects; for stock work orders it equals the total allocation). This also becomes the initial received quantity for the first step.

material.label: Material used
material.summary: The material to be used. Once the work order is approved, this material is reserved from stock.

storageLocation.label: Storage location
storageLocation.summary: Where the finished product will be stored. Choose from the storage location master. It can be left empty if not yet decided.

route.label: Step list / version
route.summary: Which sequence of steps to use. Choose from the step lists registered for the product (not used for stock work orders).

newRouteName.label: New step list name
newRouteName.summary: The name to use when creating a new step list on the spot. From then on, this sequence can be selected for the same product.

inspectionTemplates.label: Inspection sheet
inspectionTemplates.summary: The inspection sheet template(s) used for each inspection step. Multiple can be selected. Adding a step automatically selects any inspection sheet templates linked to that step.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Additional notes. These are read by shop-floor staff when they view the work order.

plant.label: Destination site
plant.summary: The site to transfer stock to. Stock at the source site decreases and stock at the destination site increases.

location.label: Storage location / shelf
location.summary: Where within the destination site to place it. Setting this makes it easier to locate the physical stock later.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: The quantity to transfer. It cannot exceed the amount available at the source.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: A field for recording the reason for the transfer, etc. The transfer is recorded in the history.

plant.label: Destination site
plant.summary: The site to transfer stock to. Stock at the source site decreases and stock at the destination site increases.

location.label: Storage location / shelf
location.summary: Where within the destination site to place it. Setting this makes it easier to locate the physical stock later.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: The quantity to transfer. It cannot exceed the amount available at the source.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: A field for recording the reason for the transfer, etc. The transfer is recorded in the history.

rejectReason.label: Reason for sending back
rejectReason.summary: The reason for sending this back. It will be shown as-is to the person who made the request.

orderLine.label: Order acceptance
orderLine.summary: Select the order acceptance this shipment is for. Once selected, its shippable order lines are filled in automatically.

type.label: Type
type.summary: The kind of shipment. Only Dispatch proceeds to a delivery note and billing.

plant.label: From site
plant.summary: The originating site recorded on the document. For a Stock storage delivery order, stock is received into this site.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary notes for the delivery order as a whole. Notes for individual lines go in each line's own Notes field.

product.label: Product
product.summary: The product being shipped. Selecting an order line fills this in automatically (you can also search and change it).

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: The quantity being shipped. It cannot exceed the lot's stock quantity or the order's remaining balance (order quantity minus already shipped).

deliveryOrder.label: Delivery order
deliveryOrder.summary: The source delivery order. Selecting one carries over that shipment's products and quantities.

deliveryMethod.label: Delivery method
deliveryMethod.summary: Standard — delivered to the ordering customer, with the delivery note enclosed in the package. Direct to end user — shipped directly to the end user; the delivery note is sent separately and normally omits pricing. Selecting a delivery order fills in the default from the order acceptance's delivery method.

recipient.label: Ship-to
recipient.summary: The addressee of the delivery note. Normally the ordering customer; for direct-to-end-user delivery, set it to match the actual delivery destination.

endUser.label: End user
endUser.summary: The actual delivery destination for direct shipments. Selecting a delivery order fills in the default from the order acceptance's end user.

includePrice.label: Include price
includePrice.summary: Whether to print the unit price and amount on the delivery note. This is normally turned off for direct-to-end-user deliveries, so the end user does not see the transaction price.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary notes for the delivery note. They appear on the delivery note PDF.

product.label: Product
product.summary: The product being delivered. Carried over from the delivery order.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.summary: The quantity being delivered. Prefilled from the delivery order's quantity.

unitPrice.label: Unit price
unitPrice.summary: The unit price printed on the delivery note. It is not printed when "Include price" is turned off.

bpCode.label: BP code
bpCode.summary: The business partner's number. Assigned automatically.

name.label: Name
name.summary: The company name. It appears exactly as entered on documents, so use the official name.

nameKana.label: Kana / Short name
nameKana.summary: Kana is used when searching by name. Short name is used to display a compact label in narrow spaces such as list views.

country.label: Country
country.summary: The partner's country. Used to identify overseas business partners.

taxNumber.label: Corporate number
taxNumber.summary: An identification number such as the corporate number. Used for reconciliation in billing and accounting.

matchNames.label: AI match names
matchNames.summary: Alternate spellings that should be recognized as the same company when incoming documents are read automatically. Listing former company names or variations in how "K.K." or "Co., Ltd." is written reduces the chance of matching to the wrong company during intake.

address.label: Postal code / Address
address.summary: The location. Appears on delivery notes and invoices.

contact.label: Phone / Fax / Email / Website
contact.summary: Contact information for the company itself. Contact details for individual people are registered separately under "Contacts."

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: Turning this off removes the partner from selection on new quotes, purchase orders, and the like. Documents already created for this company remain unchanged.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary notes. Recording the reasoning behind a decision or points to watch out for helps anyone who reviews this later understand the background.

billingBp.label: Bill-to (if a different company)
billingBp.summary: Specify this when the invoice should be addressed to a different company. If left blank, the company itself is the addressee.

paymentTerms.label: Closing day / Payment terms / Payment day
paymentTerms.summary: The payment arrangement. Billing closing runs according to the closing day set here.

creditLimit.label: Credit limit
creditLimit.summary: A guideline for the amount of credit that can be extended.

taxType.label: Tax type
taxType.summary: How consumption tax is treated. Used in invoice calculations.

invoiceMethod.label: Invoice delivery method
invoiceMethod.summary: How the invoice is delivered — Email, Fax, Post, or Portal.

consignment.label: Consignment partner
consignment.summary: Whether this partner is a consignment sales partner. Turn this on only for partners you do consignment sales with.

vendorType.label: Vendor type
vendorType.summary: Whether this is a Supplier (a partner you buy materials or supplies from) or a Subcontractor (a partner you outsource part of a process to). The company appears only in the screen for the type selected here.

leadTime.label: Standard lead time (days)
leadTime.summary: The typical number of days from placing the order to getting it back. Used as a guide when setting the expected receipt date for outsourced work.

vendorPayment.label: Closing day / Payment terms / Payment day
vendorPayment.summary: The payment arrangement for payments you make to this partner.

bank.label: Bank name / Branch name / Account type / Account number
bank.summary: The bank account to transfer payment to. Used when paying this partner.

industry.label: Industry
industry.summary: The type of industry the company is in. For end users, it is enough to register only major ones — you do not need to register every end user.

code.label: Product code
code.summary: The product's management number. It is used across all documents — quotes, order lines, work orders, and more.

name.label: Name
name.summary: The product's name. This name is printed on documents.

unit.label: Unit
unit.summary: The unit used to count the product. The default is pcs.

productType.label: Product type
productType.summary: The product's type. Selecting a type displays the specification fields defined for that type below.

materialType.label: Material type
materialType.summary: The type of material used to make this product.

dimensions.label: Diameter (mm) / Overall length (mm)
dimensions.summary: The dimensions of the material required. Specified as "material type + diameter + overall length" rather than a specific material, since any material meeting those conditions can be used.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.summary: Alternate names for this product — abbreviations, readings, English names, or alternate ways of writing the dimensions. These words are also searchable, and are matched against this product when reading order documents. Use "Suggest with AI" to generate candidates.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: Turning this off removes the product from selection on quotes and price lists.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary notes. Recording the reasoning behind a decision or points to watch out for helps anyone who reviews this later understand the background.

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer
manufacturer.summary: The material's manufacturer. Options are registered in Code numbering.

grade.label: Manufacturer grade
grade.summary: The grade within that manufacturer's lineup. Selecting a manufacturer narrows this to only that manufacturer's grades.

shape.label: Shape
shape.summary: The shape — Standard, OH, Cylinder, and so on.

name.label: Name
name.summary: The material type's name. This name appears on material and product screens.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: Turning this off removes the material type from selection for materials and products.

materialType.label: Material type
materialType.summary: The material type this material is based on. Register the material type first.

surfaceFinish.label: Surface finish
surfaceFinish.summary: The surface condition. Choose from black skin, ground, or partially ground black skin.

dimensions.label: Diameter (mm) / overall length (mm)
dimensions.summary: The material's dimensions. Both values become part of the material code.

kind.label: Kind
kind.summary: The kind defined per shape (e.g. CH or 2V30 for OH shapes).

code.label: Material code
code.summary: The code determined by the combination of material type, surface finish, diameter, and length. It is assembled automatically.

name.label: Name
name.summary: The material's name. It appears on purchase order and receipt screens.

unit.label: Unit
unit.summary: The counting unit. It becomes the default unit on purchase orders and receipts.

model.label: Manufacturer model / nominal diameter (mm)
model.summary: The manufacturer's model number and nominal diameter. Register this information to convey to the supplier when ordering.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.summary: Alternative names for this material (abbreviations, readings, English names, or alternate dimension notations). Entries here can also be used to search for the material and are matched against it when reading in documents. Use "Suggest with AI" to generate candidates.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: When turned off, the material no longer appears as an option on purchase orders or receipts.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary information. It helps to note the reasoning behind decisions and any points of caution, so that someone reviewing this later can follow the background.

code.label: Step code / name
code.summary: The step's management number and name. This name is listed on work orders.

allowedLocations.label: Allowed work locations
allowedLocations.summary: Restricts the work locations that can be used for this step's plans and actuals. You can specify by type (machine, area, etc.) or by individual location. If both are left empty, there is no restriction (all work locations can be used).

category.label: Category
category.summary: The classification: material prep, machining, coating, inspection, inspection approval, or shipping.

execution.label: Execution location
execution.summary: Whether the step is in-house only, or can be either in-house or outsourced. Allowing outsourcing lets you select a subcontractor on the work order.

quantityTracking.label: Quantity tracking
quantityTracking.summary: How quantities are handled at this step — Flow (carries the quantity forward), Inspection (counted as an inspection), or None (not recorded). The input fields on the step execution screen change depending on the mode.

defaultTime.label: Default work time
defaultTime.summary: The estimated time per occurrence. It becomes the default value when creating a work order.

sync.label: Sync capable
sync.summary: Whether this step can proceed in parallel with other steps.

inspection.label: Inspection step / inspection approval step
inspection.summary: Whether this is a step that performs inspection, or one that approves inspection results. Marking it as an inspection step allows recording an inspection sheet on the step execution screen.

approvalRank.label: Required approval rank
approvalRank.summary: The rank required to approve this step (e.g. section chief or above).

sortOrder.label: Sort order
sortOrder.summary: The display order. This also becomes the default execution order when added to a step list or work order (issuing/handover is fixed at the top, pre-shipment inspection is fixed at the bottom).

active.label: Enabled / notes
active.summary: When turned off, the step no longer appears as an option. Notes are supplementary information.

code.label: Code / name
code.summary: The template's management number and name. Selected by this name when linking it to a work order.

processStep.label: Related step
processStep.summary: The step this inspection sheet is used for. Specifying it makes the sheet easier to select on that step's execution screen.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: When turned off, it no longer appears as an option to link to work orders.

code.label: Code / name
code.summary: The defect type's management number and name. Selected by this name when recording a defect at a step.

sortOrder.label: Sort order
sortOrder.summary: The order in which options are listed. Placing frequently used ones near the top makes entry easier on the shop floor.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: When turned off, it no longer appears as an option for defect records.

name.label: Name
name.summary: The group's name. It appears with this name in the list when selecting a group for an approval flow step.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: When turned off, approvals through this group no longer take place. Member and delegate settings are configured on the detail screen.

validFrom.label: Start date/time
validFrom.summary: The date and time from which a term-limited member can begin approving. This does not apply to permanent members. Before this time, they will not appear as a candidate approver.

validUntil.label: End date/time
validUntil.summary: The date and time after which a term-limited member can no longer approve. This does not apply to permanent members. Once this time passes, approval rights are removed automatically, so there is no need to remove them manually.

stepName.label: Step name
stepName.summary: The name of this approval step. Enter a term that is understood internally, such as "First approval" or "Department approval." This name appears on the document screen and in the pending-approval list.

group.label: Approval group
group.summary: The group that approves this step. Only the members of the group selected here (or their delegates within the valid period) can approve this step.

mode.label: Approval condition
mode.summary: Whether approval by any one member is enough, or approval from all members is required. "Any one member" advances to the next step once a single person in the group approves. "All members" does not advance until every member who was in the group at the time the request was made has approved.

code.label: Site code
code.summary: The site's management number. This code is used on inventory and shipping screens.

name.label: Name / kana
name.summary: The site's name. It indicates the location for inventory, receiving, and shipping.

region.label: Country / region
region.summary: The country and region classification. It is the unit used when limiting a user's permissions to "sites in this region only."

address.label: Postal code / address
address.summary: The location. It is used as the destination address on documents.

contact.label: Phone number / email address / contact
contact.summary: Contact information. Used as the inquiry contact on documents.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: When turned off, it no longer appears as an option for receiving or shipping locations.

notes.label: Notes
notes.summary: Supplementary information. It helps to note the reasoning behind decisions and any points of caution, so that someone reviewing this later can follow the background.

code.label: Code
code.summary: A symbol that becomes part of material type codes and material codes. Decide it at registration — changing it later will break existing codes that were built using this part.

name.label: Name
name.summary: The name shown as an option on the material type and material screens.

active.label: Enabled
active.summary: Turning this off removes it from the options when registering a material type or material. Use it to hide a manufacturer or shape you no longer use, while keeping past registrations intact.

plant.label: Site
plant.summary: The site this work location belongs to. When selecting a step's execution location, only work locations at this site appear as options.

code.label: Code / Name (Japanese / English)
code.summary: The management number and name of the work location. It can be selected as a step's execution location.

type.label: Type
type.summary: The category of the work location. Used to filter the list.

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.summary: A rough guide to how much this location can handle at once. Enter 1 for a single machine, or the number of items that can be placed at once for an area.

sortOrder.label: Sort order / Enabled / Notes
sortOrder.summary: The display order, whether it appears as an option, and any additional notes.

plant.label: Site / Floor
plant.summary: The site and floor this location belongs to. Inventory is tracked by storage location at this level.

code.label: Code / Name (Japanese / English)
code.summary: The management number and name of the location. Once registered, it can be selected as a storage location for inventory.

sortOrder.label: Sort order
sortOrder.summary: The order in which it appears among the options. Smaller numbers appear first.

active.label: Enabled / Notes
active.summary: Turning this off removes it from the storage location options. Notes are for additional remarks.

plants.label: Assigned sites
plants.summary: The sites this user is responsible for. Multiple sites can be selected.

showSystemFiles.label: Show system files
showSystemFiles.summary: Whether to show OS/tool leftover files such as ".DS_Store" or "*.tmp". Keep this off normally, and turn it on only when you want to clean them up.

grantFolder.label: Folder (path prefix match)
grantFolder.summary: The folder to grant access to. Since this matches by path prefix, everything under the specified folder is included.

grantUser.label: User
grantUser.summary: The person who will be able to view this folder.

grantWrite.label: Also allow writing
grantWrite.summary: When turned on, the user can place and delete files, not just view them. Grant this only to people who need it.

count.label: Number of cards to issue
count.summary: The number of cards to create at once. Newly created cards are not yet assigned to anyone.

user.label: Assign to user
user.summary: The person who will use this card. Once assigned, they can log in by tapping the card on a shop-floor tablet.

name.label: Device name (Japanese / English)
name.summary: The name shown in the list, on the floor map, and on activity-log badges. Use a name that lets people locate the physical device, such as "Plant 1 entrance".

plant.label: Site
plant.summary: The site where this device is located. Devices are listed grouped by site.

location.label: Location
location.summary: Where the device is placed within the site. Placing a pin on the floor map lets you see its position on screen as well.

defaultWorkLocation.label: Default work location
defaultWorkLocation.summary: The work location automatically recorded in the work record when a step is started or resumed on this device. Set it to the machine or area where the device is placed. It can also be changed from the device settings screen on the tablet itself (authenticated with the setup code).

linkCode.label: Link code
linkCode.summary: The verification code shown on the tablet's screen. First create the device profile on this screen, then scan (or type in) the code shown on the tablet to link that profile with the physical device.

itemName.label: Item name (Japanese / English)
itemName.summary: The name of the field shown on the product screen. Enter both Japanese and English.

key.label: Key (identifier)
key.summary: The alphanumeric name used to store this field. Decide it at registration — changing it later will disconnect it from values already entered.

type.label: Type
type.summary: The kind of value, such as text or number. The type determines which of the settings below apply — minimum/maximum for numbers, a pattern for text.

default.label: Default value (base)
default.summary: The value used when nothing is entered. Setting a commonly used value reduces manual input.

placeholder.label: Placeholder
placeholder.summary: An example shown faintly in the input field. It is not saved as a value.

required.label: Make required
required.summary: When turned on, the product cannot be saved while this field is left empty.

pattern.label: Pattern (regular expression)
pattern.summary: A rule for the shape of the text. Use this only when you want to enforce a specific format.

range.label: Minimum / Maximum
range.summary: The allowed range of values for a numeric field.

typeName.label: Type name (Japanese / English)
typeName.summary: The name selected when creating a product.

typeDescription.label: Description
typeDescription.summary: A note explaining what kind of product this type is used for.

typeActive.label: Enabled
typeActive.summary: Turning this off removes it from the options when creating a product. Products already created with this type remain unchanged.

typeItems.label: Items
typeItems.summary: The fields shown on the product screen when this type is selected. Choose from the product items created above.

typeDefault.label: Default value (override)
typeDefault.summary: Enter this only if you want a different default value for this field specifically when this type is selected. If left empty, the default value from the product item is used.
